## Summary

Describe the behavior, security consideration or documentation improvement. Link the issue.

Closes #

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests, typecheck and builds run (provide commands and output)
- [ ] Cross-repository compatibility or migration notes supplied where applicable
- [ ] UI states cover loading, empty, errors, denied wallet and wrong-network situations
- [ ] Privacy and security implications considered and documented
- [ ] No private keys, spend notes, witness values, KYC, real fiat data or provider credentials included
- [ ] No invented corridor, pricing, transactions, assets or partner integrations added to runtime code
- [ ] No unsupported privacy, audit or mainnet-readiness claims
- [ ] No deployment or external service action performed without authorization

## Status (check only what is true)

- [ ] Proposed / architecture only
- [ ] Implemented in code
- [ ] Passed CI checks
- [ ] Independently verified on Stellar Testnet (add evidence)
- [ ] Deployed on Testnet (link contract ID and transaction history)

## Review notes

For UI changes, add mobile and desktop screenshots. For protocol changes, link threat model, ADR and public input / authorization tests. Note limits and follow-up work.
